THE REPORT’S OWN FUNNEL

It counts organisations, not pilots.

03 / 34
Evaluated a tool60%
Reached a pilot20%
Reached production5%

The report measured something narrower. Ninety-five per cent of organisations were getting zero return on their investment. That is a statement about companies, not about projects. The report also published its own funnel for task-specific tools. Sixty per cent of organisations evaluated such tools. Twenty per cent reached a pilot. Five per cent reached production.

Five out of the twenty that piloted therefore made it through. On the report's own numbers, the pilot failure rate is seventy-five per cent. That is still poor. It is twenty percentage points better than the figure in circulation.
